jobs.descriptionText:
The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The VP Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities:
Assume significant levels of responsibility for the various phases of project and transaction execution, new business development and overall growth of the firm
Work closely with clients on financing transactions and guide them through the capital raising process, including leading due diligence and drafting sessions and preparing them for an equity or debt offering
Work with clients, senior-level team members and outside professional advisors on M&A and special situation transactions
Responsible for drafting situation analyses, pitch materials, information memoranda, investor and management presentations and oversee work being performed by analysts & associates assigned to projects
Recommended Qualifications:
6-10 years of experience
Experience in the Financial Services industry, specifically within Banking
Degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration
MBA or Master's Degree in Business preferred
Comprehensive knowledge of the corporate banking business and its related products, pertinent regulations and lending and credit approval processes
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Experience with large corporate clients, capital markets products, derivatives, credit, cash management, trade, finance and securities products
Series 7 and 63 preferred
Education:
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
Sectoral Experience: Candidates should demonstrate deep sector expertise and established client relationships in one or more of the following coverage areas relevant to the China onshore market:
TMT
Industrial
Healthcare & Life Sciences
Financials Institutions Group
Natural Resources & Energy
Consumer & Retail
Real Estate & Infrastructure
Education & Government Services
Automotive & New Energy Vehicles (NEV)
Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
Lead day-to-day execution of M&A advisory, ECM, and strategic transactions, managing Associates and Analysts across workstreams
Take primary responsibility for financial analysis, valuation, deal structuring, and negotiation support
Develop and maintain client relationships at the CFO, VP Finance, and business development level within target sector accounts
Drive pitch preparation and business development efforts in collaboration with Directors and MDs
Manage regulatory interactions with the CSRC, SSE, SZSE, and relevant government bodies for onshore transactions
Provide sector-specific market intelligence and strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
Mentor and develop junior team members, providing structured feedback and deal coaching
Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

The Salesperson is an intermediate-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The AVP Salesperson also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities:
Refine and implement sales/marketing strategy to improve Citi's client footprint and maximize associated revenue while working with management/colleagues to establish a clear marketing plan with defined priorities, market penetration and revenue goals
Leverage contact network, understand client needs, introduce the Citi offering, convince clients to adopt it and increase client satisfaction and Citi revenue
Advise team in strategic positioning and closing transactions with various internal stakeholders (structuring, trading, legal, credit and risk etc.)
Forge a relationship with salespeople in order to leverage Citi's franchise and source relevant buying and selling opportunities for clients
Lead strong governance and controls
Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation
Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
Adhere to all policies and procedures as defined by your role which will be communicated to you
Obtain and maintain all registrations/licenses which are required for your role, within the appropriate timeframe
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications:
5-8 years of relevant experience
Experience in a client-facing role working with the buy-side community
Sales experience at a financial services organization
Proven interpersonal and problem-solving skills
Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
Broad client relationships preferred
Must have or be able to obtain required licenses including Series 3, 7, 55 and 63
Education:
Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.descriptionText:
Citibank China Company Ltd. (‘CCCL’) is Citibank’s locally incorporated subsidiary with full-fledged banking license serving the Mainland China market. Second Line of Defense (‘2LoD’) oversight for Liquidity Risk, Non-Trading Market Risk (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book - IRRBB), and Balance Sheet Risks is executed by Finance CRO (FinCRO).
The Treasury Risk Vice President (C13) leads independent 2LoD oversight, risk limit framework design/recalibration, quantitative risk analysis, and credible challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk and Liquidity Risk across CCCL.
The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.
Job Background / Context
CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).
The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
Scenario Design & Assumptions: Assess the severity and relevance of idiosyncratic, systemic, and combined stress scenarios; review cash flow projections, deposit runoff assumptions, contingent liquidity draws, and wholesale funding rollovers.
HQLA Buffer Sizing: Evaluate the sizing, composition, currency mix, and unencumbered status of CCCL’s High-Quality Liquid Assets buffer.
Regulatory Compliance & Standards (Liquidity & IRRBB)
Liquidity Regulatory Ratios: Ensure continuous 2LoD monitoring and compliance with PBOC and NFRA regulatory ratios, including Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Liquidity Ratio (LR), and Net Cumulative Outflow metrics.
IRRBB Regulatory Frameworks: Ensure strict compliance with NFRA IRRBB Guidelines for Commercial Banks, PBOC macroprudential requirements, and Basel BCBS 368 standards.
Supervisory Outlier Tests (SOT): Lead the 2LoD assessment, validation, and monitoring of regulatory SOT for
Regulatory Reporting & Exams: Oversee and validate local regulatory IRRBB returns, interest rate repricing gap schedules, and supervisory stress test submissions; provide technical risk support for PBOC/NFRA examinations and inquiries.
Regulatory Change: Track, interpret, and drive the implementation of evolving prudential standards across IRRBB, Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book (CSRBB), and liquidity metrics (BCBS 248 / Basel III/IV).
Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) & Modeling Assumptions
IRRBB Metrics Oversight: Review, analyze, and challenge banking book interest rate risk metrics, including Economic Value of Equity (EVE) sensitivity, Earnings at Risk (EaR), and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity.
Behavioral Assumptions: Review and challenge behavioral modeling assumptions for non-maturity deposits (NMDs), loan prepayments, deposit early redemptions, and Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) rules.
Variance & P&L Attribution: Supervise detailed variance analysis and driver attribution explaining balance sheet metric movements.
Governance, Committee Presentation & Risk Culture
Senior Governance Forums: Prepare risk analytics and actively participate in the Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), Country Risk Management Committee (RMC), and Country Coordination Committee (CCC).
ICAAP & Resolution Planning: Provide critical 2LoD input and independent challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) and Liquidity Risk sections of the ICAAP and Recovery & Resolution Plans.
Audit & Control Remediation: Serve as primary risk contact for Internal Audit and external regulatory examinations; drive the timely remediation of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and Manager's Control Assessments (MCA).
Conduct & Ethics: Uphold the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and compliance, transparently managing and escalating risk and control issues.
Development Value
Direct Franchise Impact: High-visibility role managing and defending the treasury, IRRBB, and liquidity risk profile of Citi's onshore China banking franchise (CCCL).
Senior Stakeholder Exposure: Strategic interface with senior franchise leadership (CCCL CRO, Treasurer, CFO, and Regional FinCRO heads).
Regulatory & Technical Mastery: Advanced exposure to onshore PBOC/NFRA and Basel regulatory regimes, leading limit recalibration, stress testing, and supervisory outlier evaluations.
Career Growth: High-impact leadership track offering clear progression into broader regional Treasury Risk and Country CRO roles.
Person Specification
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Risk Management, Financial Engineering, or Accounting. Master’s degree or professional certifications (FRM, CFA) strongly preferred.
Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth technical mastery of Liquidity Risk (LCR, NSFR, ILST, intraday liquidity, collateral management) and IRRBB / ALM (EVE, EaR, NII sensitivity, yield curve modeling, CSRBB).
Experience: 6–10+ years of relevant experience in Treasury Risk Management, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet / ALM Risk, or Non-Trading Market Risk in banking or financial institutions.
Limit Calibration & Analytics: Proven expertise in designing, quantitatively calibrating, and backtesting risk limits, stress scenarios, and early warning trigger frameworks.
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of PBOC and NFRA regulatory rules, reporting standards, Basel III/IV frameworks, BCBS 248 intraday metrics, and BCBS 368 IRRBB standards.
Credible Challenge: Confident executive presence with the ability to provide robust, credible challenge to 1LoD Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and business heads.
Legal Entity Risk: Experience working within a locally incorporated bank subsidiary or material legal entity environment.
Technical Tools: High proficiency in Advanced Excel/VBA, SQL, and financial risk engines; experience with Python or BI tools and applying AI/automation to streamline workflows.
Language Skills: Full professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin (Putonghua) is mandatory.
Communication & Governance: Strong communication and memo-writing skills to articulate complex balance sheet, liquidity, and rate risk dynamics clearly to senior governance committees (ALCO/RMC/Board).
Examinations & Audits: Prior experience participating in regulatory examinations, risk assessments, and internal audits.
Execution & Resilience: Self-driven, highly organized, and capable of prioritizing and delivering under tight timelines.

  • The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.

Job Background / Context

CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).

The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
  • Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
  • Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
  • Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
  • Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
  • Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
  • Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
  • Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
  • Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
  • Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
  • Scenario Design & Assumptions: Assess the severity and relevance of idiosyncratic, systemic, and combined stress scenarios; review cash flow projections, deposit runoff assumptions, contingent liquidity draws, and wholesale funding rollovers.
  • HQLA Buffer Sizing: Evaluate the sizing, composition, currency mix, and unencumbered status of CCCL’s High-Quality Liquid Assets buffer.
  • Regulatory Compliance & Standards (Liquidity & IRRBB)
  • Liquidity Regulatory Ratios: Ensure continuous 2LoD monitoring and compliance with PBOC and NFRA regulatory ratios, including Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Liquidity Ratio (LR), and Net Cumulative Outflow metrics.
  • IRRBB Regulatory Frameworks: Ensure strict compliance with NFRA IRRBB Guidelines for Commercial Banks, PBOC macroprudential requirements, and Basel BCBS 368 standards.
  • Supervisory Outlier Tests (SOT): Lead the 2LoD assessment, validation, and monitoring of regulatory SOT for
  • Regulatory Reporting & Exams: Oversee and validate local regulatory IRRBB returns, interest rate repricing gap schedules, and supervisory stress test submissions; provide technical risk support for PBOC/NFRA examinations and inquiries.
  • Regulatory Change: Track, interpret, and drive the implementation of evolving prudential standards across IRRBB, Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book (CSRBB), and liquidity metrics (BCBS 248 / Basel III/IV).
  • Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) & Modeling Assumptions
  • IRRBB Metrics Oversight: Review, analyze, and challenge banking book interest rate risk metrics, including Economic Value of Equity (EVE) sensitivity, Earnings at Risk (EaR), and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity.
  • Behavioral Assumptions: Review and challenge behavioral modeling assumptions for non-maturity deposits (NMDs), loan prepayments, deposit early redemptions, and Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) rules.
  • Variance & P&L Attribution: Supervise detailed variance analysis and driver attribution explaining balance sheet metric movements.
  • Governance, Committee Presentation & Risk Culture
  • Senior Governance Forums: Prepare risk analytics and actively participate in the Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO), Country Risk Management Committee (RMC), and Country Coordination Committee (CCC).
  • ICAAP & Resolution Planning: Provide critical 2LoD input and independent challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk (IRRBB) and Liquidity Risk sections of the ICAAP and Recovery & Resolution Plans.
  • Audit & Control Remediation: Serve as primary risk contact for Internal Audit and external regulatory examinations; drive the timely remediation of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) and Manager's Control Assessments (MCA).
  • Conduct & Ethics: Uphold the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and compliance, transparently managing and escalating risk and control issues.

Development Value

  • Direct Franchise Impact: High-visibility role managing and defending the treasury, IRRBB, and liquidity risk profile of Citi's onshore China banking franchise (CCCL).
  • Senior Stakeholder Exposure: Strategic interface with senior franchise leadership (CCCL CRO, Treasurer, CFO, and Regional FinCRO heads).
  • Regulatory & Technical Mastery: Advanced exposure to onshore PBOC/NFRA and Basel regulatory regimes, leading limit recalibration, stress testing, and supervisory outlier evaluations.
  • Career Growth: High-impact leadership track offering clear progression into broader regional Treasury Risk and Country CRO roles.

Person Specification

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Quantitative Risk Management, Financial Engineering, or Accounting. Master’s degree or professional certifications (FRM, CFA) strongly preferred.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: In-depth technical mastery of Liquidity Risk (LCR, NSFR, ILST, intraday liquidity, collateral management) and IRRBB / ALM (EVE, EaR, NII sensitivity, yield curve modeling, CSRBB).
  • Experience: 6–10+ years of relevant experience in Treasury Risk Management, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet / ALM Risk, or Non-Trading Market Risk in banking or financial institutions.
  • Limit Calibration & Analytics: Proven expertise in designing, quantitatively calibrating, and backtesting risk limits, stress scenarios, and early warning trigger frameworks.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of PBOC and NFRA regulatory rules, reporting standards, Basel III/IV frameworks, BCBS 248 intraday metrics, and BCBS 368 IRRBB standards.
  • Credible Challenge: Confident executive presence with the ability to provide robust, credible challenge to 1LoD Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and business heads.
  • Legal Entity Risk: Experience working within a locally incorporated bank subsidiary or material legal entity environment.
  • Technical Tools: High proficiency in Advanced Excel/VBA, SQL, and financial risk engines; experience with Python or BI tools and applying AI/automation to streamline workflows.
  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin (Putonghua) is mandatory.
  • Communication & Governance: Strong communication and memo-writing skills to articulate complex balance sheet, liquidity, and rate risk dynamics clearly to senior governance committees (ALCO/RMC/Board).
  • Examinations & Audits: Prior experience participating in regulatory examinations, risk assessments, and internal audits.
  • Execution & Resilience: Self-driven, highly organized, and capable of prioritizing and delivering under tight timelines.

jobs.descriptionText:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Strategy & Setup:
Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)
Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:
Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.
Team Leadership & Development:
Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.
Core Operations Management:
Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management:
Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.
Financial & Performance Management:
Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.
Qualifications
Experience:
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
Knowledge & Skills:
In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Education & Language:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

Demonstrates sound credit skills by being able to structure more complex deals, which can include capital market transactions

Responsibilities:
Build relationships with Citi network and operational teams, becoming one of the key contacts for clients’ requests, internal requests/escalation and resolution.
Support Senior Relationship manager in management of assigned portfolio of clients.
Work closely with Senior Relationship Managers to ensure we provide a 'Client First' approach and help to deliver outstanding day to day banking & operational support to our Mid-Market clients.
In cooperation with Senior Relationship Manager calls on clients and maximise ‘One Citi’ client experience, by proactively leveraging and sharing Citi’s market leading insights, global network and solutions.
Monitor and support products’ implementation processes, clients on-boarding process and manage sales CRM platform.
Liaise with Relationship Associate to ensure adherence to global KYC (Know Your Customer) standards during the onboarding process and, on an ongoing basis, ensuring the appropriate compliance deliverables are met.
Develops and maintains strong ties with Commercial Banking teams across the globe, in particular CCB colleagues working across the same sector vertical, CCB colleagues supporting subsidiary businesses overseas (Commercial Subsidiaries Group). Collaborate and work closely with various product teams (cash sales, trade finance, markets, corporate finance), Underwriting / Risk teams.
Work with Senior Relationship Managers to analyse client relationships, risks & opportunities, assists with credit application write-up, financial spreading, deal structuring, returns calculation, documentation review & preparation. Administrate the credit relationship of clients, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes.
Understand key commercial banking processes & solutions, including Transactional Banking, FX, Trade, Treasury, Working Capital and Lending products.
Support Senior Relationship Managers on solutioning assessment, preparation of pitch books and meeting materials, assists with new clients’ acquisition.
Work collaboratively with key internal stakeholders across CCB, share best practice across teams in order to deliver 'best in class' relationship management to new and existing clients.

Working within Commercial/Corporate banking is desirable.
Experience in a Client Relationship role or client facing role.
Sales, presentation and communication skills. Focus on first class service quality.
Analytical and credit skills
High level of self-motivation
Knowledge of general banking processes, general understanding of commercial banking solutions
Ability to build & develop strong client relationships.
Effective collaboration skills with Senior Relationship Managers and Commercial Banking partners
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft and CRM applications

The Network Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for assisting with network related activities, including network installation, maintenance, technical guidance, and security in coordination with the Citi standard.
The overall objective is to support new company setup and continue to provide network support for securities company in BAU.
Responsibilities:
Be responsible for the operational support of network for Citi China securities company, which includes multiple platforms, manufacturers, and technologies.
Participates in collaborating with various internal groups and external vendors to ensure all installations meet specifications.
Provide fast response to network problems of high priority, severity, and impact, escalating as appropriate.
Act directly on incidents and tasks of greater complexity or priority assigned to the team.
Excellent interpersonal relations and communication and persuasive skills; be able to manage communication with multiple audiences during problem-solving and crisis management.
Keep up with the Citi network/infra standard, act as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
Collect business requirement and interpret to proper technical components and support business to follow proper process
Assist project team on service ensure timely project delivery
Manage vendor on proper service delivery
Support and assist regional operation team on incident handling
Communicate with relevant teams to provide frequent status updates regarding the technical issue, status of the remediation efforts, and ongoing business impact
Exchange ideas and information in a concise and clear manner
Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:
5-8 years of experience in a network engineer role (education/professional) with demonstrated knowledge of operational process change and improvement
CCNA or above
Experience in networks and telecommunications in large-scale environments, such as Carrier, Manufacturers, Multi-Account Global Services, or a large-scale enterprise environment.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Effective diagnostic and analysis skills. Mature analytical and communications skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
Experience in Financial Services or a broad global or complex environment preferred.
Ability to provide rapid response to problems, leading multidisciplinary teams virtually.
Ability to work with personal and virtual teams and work under pressure or for rapid resolution of critical incidents
Hands on experience on China Securities industry
Education:
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate, Healthcare Team
Research Analyst(Junior), Officer
jobs.descriptionText:
The Research Associate is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.
Responsibilities:
Reviews and processes broker votes to be shared and consumed
Organizes the product management team including creation of presentations, marketing schedules, coordination of the marketing diary, product planning meetings, diary management etc.
Publishes focus list notes, updating and displaying the new focus list posters etc.
Contributes to market data and subscriptions management for Equity Research
Responsible for collation, co-ordination and organization of Road Ahead conference, stock steering meetings
Assists with year-end scorecard preparation, result analysis, goals and training
Provides management information including variance analysis, month-end reporting etc.
Conducts expense management including travel and entertainment pre-approvals, client interaction spend pre-approval e.g. GLG, non-network individuals etc.
Manages and prepares Committee quality reviews
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:
MBA and/or CFA preferred
Existing knowledge of Research or external Investment research division essential
History of working within tight deadlines and prioritization
Microsoft systems especially Excel and Word
Ability to interact and manage at all levels ability to manage large amounts of data ability to use internal Citi systems would be an advantage but is not essential.
Accuracy and attention to detail
Secure and maintain applicable licenses
Education:
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Production Support Technology Assistant Vice President - China Securities NewCo
jobs.descriptionText:
The Apps Support Sr Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
Responsibilities:
The Application Support Senior Analyst provides technical and business support for users of Citi Applications. This includes providing quick resolutions to app issues, driving stability, efficiency and effectiveness improvements to help us and the business succeed.
Maintains application systems that have completed the development stage and are running in the daily operations of the firm.
Manages, maintains and supports applications and their operating environments, focusing on stability, quality and functionality against service level expectations.
Start of day checks, continuous monitoring, and regional handover.
Perform same day risk reconciliations
Develop and maintain technical support documentation.
Identifies ways to maximize the potential of the applications used
Assess risk and impact of production issues and escalate to business and technology management in a timely manner.
Ensures that storage and archiving procedures are in place and functioning correctly
Formulates and defines scope and objectives for complex application enhancements and problem resolution
Reviews and develops application contingency planning to ensure availability to users.
Partners with appropriate development and production support areas to prioritize bug fixes and support tooling requirements.
Participate in application releases, from development, testing and deployment into production.
Engages in post implementation analysis to ensure successful system design and functionality.
Considers implications of the application of technology to the current environment. Identifies risks, vulnerabilities and security issues; communicates impact.
Ensures essential procedures are followed and helps to define operating standards and processes.
Act as a liaison between users/traders, interfacing internal technology groups and vendors.
Expected to be able to raise problems to appropriate technology and business teams, while adhering to Service Level Agreements.
Acts as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts.
Provides evaluative judgment based on analysis of factual information in complicated and unique situations.
Directly impacts the business by ensuring the quality of work provided by self and others; impacts own team and closely related work teams.
Exhibits sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
Active involvement in and ownership of Support Project items, covering Stability, Efficiency, and Effectiveness initiatives.
Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications:
5-8 years experience in an Application Support role.
Experience installing, configuring or supporting business applications.
Experience with some programming languages and willingness/ability to learn.
Advanced execution capabilities and ability to adjust quickly to changes and re-prioritization
Effective written and verbal communications including ability to explain technical issues in simple terms that non-IT staff can understand.
Demonstrated analytical skills
Issue tracking and reporting using tools
Knowledge/ experience of problem Management Tools.
Good all-round technical skills
Effectively share information with other support team members and with other technology teams
Ability to plan and organize workload
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
Ability to communicate appropriately to relevant stakeholder
Hands on experience on China Securities industry or similar experience
Technical skills:
SQL programming (Oracle and Mongo DB experience is plus)
Unix basic and intermediary level skills
Job Schedulers (Autosys, Airflow experience is plus)
Basic knowledge of Documentum, Tableau, Workflow
Education:
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionText:
Description:
Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.
Citi Research is seeking a
Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO)
to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!
Key Responsibilities:
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:
Have passed the examination uniformly organized by the CSRC for securities business personnel; Securities Association of China (SAC) test.
Holding a FINRA Series-16 license is a major advantage. We may also consider strong candidates without Series-16 and would sponsor them to sit the exam, including providing study materials. Quick study prep time and then successfully passing this challenging exam is a requirement for the role.
Candidate should have at least five years of experience creating, supporting, or editing investment/financial analytic content. Candidate should be a fluent Chinese and English speaker with evidence of editorial and writing capability.
We expect candidates to have strong familiarity with financial markets, financial terminology, and ongoing business news in PRC, Asia, and globally.
Ability to prioritize and to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously amid tight deadlines.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound and balanced judgment.
Meticulous and detail oriented. Key aspects of the role involve being able to remember and apply many guidelines and procedures on a consistent and reliable basis.
Team members should have comfort working with sometimes complex publishing software platforms (e.g. Sinitek) and ability to coordinate with partner teams when trouble-shooting technical issues.
Team player with good interpersonal skills, and the patience and diplomacy to work with demanding internal customers and effectively find win-win solutions.
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
|CSTC|HQCT|C13|YIN|GLN|LP|WY
Other Key Requirements:
Bachelor’s undergraduate university degree or higher
PRC nationality
Have complete civil capacity; be of good moral character, fair-minded and honest, and possess sound professional ethics.
Have not incurred any criminal penalty or any serious administrative penalty related to securities or futures business.

jobs.descriptionText:
The Client Onboard Analyst 1 is a trainee professional role. Requires a good knowledge of the range of processes, procedures and systems to be used in carrying out assigned tasks and a basic understanding of the underlying concepts and principles upon which the job is based. Good understanding of how the team interacts with others in accomplishing the objectives of the area. Makes evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information. They are expected to resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. Must be able to exchange information in a concise and logical way as well as be sensitive to audience diversity. Limited but direct impact on the business through the quality of the tasks/services provided. Impact of the job holder is restricted to own job.
Responsibilities:
Processes client’s requests related to system set up including signatories’ updates and documentation lodgment.
Co-operates with internal partners to perform systems maintenance based on documentation related to account opening and maintenance processes.
Provides response to client and internal inquiries.
Prepares documentation for archiving .
Applies appropriate bank’s regulations while processing the requests.
Remains up to date with the current procedures, internal rules, external regulations, and follows the changes in the aforementioned documents.
Documents operation procedure updates.
Processes clients’ instructions ensuring the highest accuracy and effectiveness (ensuring deadlines are adhered to).
Verification and authorization of data entered in the systems.
Ensures all queries are dealt with in an efficient and timely manner.
Escalates urgent / risk issues through the appropriate escalation channels.
Co-operates with and supports other teams/employees upon supervisor’s instruction, including possibility of movement to another team and/or process.
Performs other crucial tasks instructed by supervisors, e.g. participation in trainings, projects, conference calls, systems’ testing.
Ensures high levels of client satisfaction through strong product, process and client knowledge. Identifies and suggests process improvements.
Assists in the implementation of validated process improvements.
Understands procedures and controls for operational processes. Supports Manager with quality assurance process. Understands procedures and controls for operational processes. Performs within departmental procedures and compliance standards in order to minimize losses.
Responsible for coordination of projects around internal processes. Participates in user acceptance test of new systems.
Effective execution of day-to-day responsibilities, as well as execution of any other work instructed by supervisor related to this function.
Daily deliverable of routine and defined tasks, while developing knowledge of the broader context in which work is being performed.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:
Previous experience in financial services preferred.
Knowledge of Markets products, KYC as well as opening and maintaining of Markets Trading accounts Customer communication experience (internal/external). Knowledge on the field of finances and banking.
Flexibility, team spirit, loyalty. High attention to detail. Good PC skills (Excel, Word). Fluent in both written and spoken English. Be able to work under pressure and to meet deadlines. Proficient knowledge of English (written and spoken).
Education:
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Banking - Commercial Banking, Summer Analyst, China – APAC, 2027
jobs.descriptionText:
We want to hear from you if...
You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 – June 2028).
Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit...
Work experience is not a requirement, but dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring Analysts who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you.
We'll also be looking for the following:
Enthusiasm, competency, and innovation
Someone with a global outlook
Interest in working with local SME
Results-oriented and a good team player
Someone who is highly numerate with first-class analytical skills
We encourage early applications as we recruit on a rolling basis. Each applicant can apply to maximum of 3 summer internship programs in Asia cluster.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program trains and cultivates key pipeline for our Full-time Analyst Program. Summer Analysts will be part of a 10-week program will be assigned in Citi's key businesses or functions allowing them to work on project for an in-depth and immersive experience. Summer Analysts will also go through trainings that will provide essential skills knowledge as well as a comprehensive orientation to Citi's culture. To support your growth, you will also participate in buddy programs, networking events, speaker series, and other structured development opportunities.
Your time here will look something like this...
The Summer Analyst Program is dedicated to giving future business leaders a complete view of Citi's business. Through mentorship, training and career development programming, Summer Analysts can expect to finish the program with broad understanding of the Commercial Banking business, as well as operational intricacies of Citi.
Tailored projects for Summer Analysts could be within these business areas:
Relationship management
Credit Lending Management
Client segment strategy
Business planning and analysis
Know Your Customer (KYC) and Control
Process design
You're the brains behind our work.
You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network. we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team, and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.
Citi’s Banking is looking for Summer Interns to join Commercial Banking team in Asia. Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) is a global line of business at Citigroup that provides commercial banking services to mid-sized companies. CCB aspires to be the global bank of choice for trade-oriented companies, with revenues between $10MM - $3B. CCB wants our clients to see us as trusted thought partners who bring simplicity in an increasingly complex world, provide client-centric solutions for long term growth and pave the way for them to reach across borders and achieve their global vision. The main products and services, that support the Commercial Bank target segment, include: Lending, Cash Management, Trade, Foreign Exchange, Interest Rate Derivatives and Capital Markets solutions. In Asia, CCB has operations in 12 countries and jurisdictions (approximately 1,200 employees) with local and international expertise contributed by our bankers, underwriters, treasury management and client service staff located in each of the 12 countries and jurisdictions. CCB Asia is a significant business for Citi in Asia and for CCB globally.

jobs.title: Services - Summer Analyst, China, 2027
jobs.descriptionText:
You're the brains behind our work.
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.
What is Services?
Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.
In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.

Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth.
Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk.

Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

You are a junior in college, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028, with a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook.
You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn.
Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit…
We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication skills.
A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail.
Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter.
A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.
Your future at Citi
Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services.
Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!

Details of the Division and Team

As a leading international bank in FICC business with unrivalled breadth of markets access, we are dedicated to making markets and working with stakeholders serving our clients across the global, providing client solutions in a wide range of EM products. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.
About Fidelity Dalian
Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.
Team Description
Asset Management CAO
team
is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management.
The Investment Management Solutions team
is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the
Sustainable Investing Solutions team
is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.
About Your Role
As the
SI Solutions - Analyst
, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.
About You
The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.

Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS
Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.
OPERATIONS
Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading, and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this vital service delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm’s assets and its reputation.
The Futures Operations team supports the clearing and settlement of futures and options contracts in China markets, the primary daily responsibilities include processing, validating and settling futures transactions. The team has extensive interaction with internal and external parties to ensure effective oversight for existing business but also to shape and implement solutions for new products, strategies and systems.
We are looking for a highly motivated individual, who is a team player. This person needs to multi-task well, have excellent client service skills and possess good organizational skills and be able to adapt quickly to an ever-changing list of issues. Additionally, the role will require extensive coordination and communication with various operations teams and professionals across the firm.
How You Will Fulfill Your Potential
Working with a team of Operations professionals in providing critical front to back trading support
Identify gaps in processing and make recommendations to close those gaps
Establish relationships with brokers, custodians and vendors to streamline workflow wherever possible
Lead projects, e.g. new business designs, architecture transformation and process automation, etc.
Act as escalation point to senior Operations managers for issue resolution
Conduit to business stakeholders in influencing decision making
Skills & Experience We’re Looking For
Attention to detail and good follow up skills
Demonstrate leadership and ownership of issue resolution
Self-motivated and driven to achieve
Analytical in identifying solutions to problems
Ability to manage pressure and prioritize multiple tasks daily
Team-player, excellent communication skills
Excellent spoken and written English and Mandarin
Preferred Qualifications
Minimum of 4 years of experience working in Operations from China onshore futures brokers, especially on KYC & Client onboarding
Understanding of local regulatory and market practice
China Futures Association qualified
About Goldman Sachs
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

This role is responsible for raising capital from ultra high net worth individuals and family offices for a range of investment opportunities offered by the firm, including mutual funds and alternative solutions, and both direct strategies and fund-of-funds.

You will work closely with advisors and clients to deliver investment and portfolio solutions.

The role offers the opportunity to build both investment expertise and client engagement skills, while contributing to a growing regional platform alongside a collaborative global team.

Responsibilities

Client Solutions & Delivery

Work with advisors and clients to develop and deliver investment and risk management solutions. Review client portfolios and help identify ideas aligned with their objectives.

Platform & Strategy Support

Develop, assess and deliver the solutions across mutual funds and alternatives on China onshore platform. Liaise and negotiate with fund managers and legal on distribution agreement. Provide ongoing oversight into the solutions offered to clients to ensure compliance with local regulations and compatibility with global risk appetite.

Client Engagement & Growth

Build strong relationships with advisors and clients, helping communicate investment ideas clearly and supporting broader client engagement and business development efforts. Organize roadshow and fund raise for both mutual funds and alternative strategies.

Team Collaboration & Regional Build-Out

Be part of a growing China onshore team, working closely with colleagues across Hong Kong and global teams to deliver consistent, high-quality solutions.

Skills & Experience

We are looking for candidates who are curious, collaborative, and interested in building a career within PWM and broader markets-focused investing.

  • Experience in financial markets, investments, fund distribution/onshore funds experiences, or related areas (typically 8-15 years), with some client exposure
  • Familiarity with equity markets and portfolio concepts; deep understanding of financial markets and investment instruments
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain ideas in a simple and effective way
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and functions. Candidate with project management is preferred
  • Driven individual with solid work ethic
  • Bachelor’s degree required. Proficient in English and Mandarin Chinese
