We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Product Director, Document Intelligence
Role Purpose
The Product Director, Document Intelligence will own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for HSBC’s enterprise Document Intelligence proposition. The role will establish a coherent, reusable set of capabilities that enables value streams to ingest, understand and act on information contained in documents at scale.
Reporting to the Group Head of Product, Enterprise AI Tooling & Digital Experience, the role will work closely with Group AI Platform and value-stream teams to shape a broader enterprise proposition spanning Document Studio and other document-processing capabilities. It will create one strategic destination for common capabilities, reducing duplication while preserving flexibility for genuinely specialised business requirements.
The Product Director will actively promote the Document Intelligence platforms, build and own the prioritisation of a pipeline of high-value, document-heavy use cases, and lead value streams from discovery through onboarding and scaled adoption using clear self-service, co-build and higher-touch delivery paths.
The role will ensure the proposition can deliver the accuracy, resilience, capacity and economics required at Group scale, with transparent measures of performance, consumption and value enablement. Value streams will remain accountable for realised business and financial outcomes.
Principal Accountabilities
Product strategy and roadmap — Define the vision, target experience and sequenced roadmap for enterprise Document Intelligence, balancing business priorities, reusable capabilities, platform maturity, dependencies and economics.
Demand, prioritisation and engagement — Promote the platforms, build and own a transparent pipeline of high-value use cases, and establish a single intake process that assesses value, reuse potential, capability fit, complexity, controls and effort before routing demand through self-service, co-build or higher-touch delivery.
Workflow transformation and adoption — Partner with value streams to define the problem, baseline and value hypothesis; validate feasibility early; redesign end-to-end workflows; and embed solutions into live journeys with the controls, integration, communications, training and change needed for sustained adoption.
Reusable capabilities and ecosystem integration — Prioritise reusable document capabilities and ensure they are consumable through appropriate interfaces, APIs and integrations with Group AI Platform, model services, RAG and knowledge capabilities, Agent Hub, orchestration and downstream systems.
Portfolio convergence and operating model — Set clear boundaries and decision rights between the enterprise platform and value streams; lead evidence-based reuse, co-build, extend or retire decisions; and enable approved services and reusable innovations to be consumed or contributed without creating parallel platforms.
Quality, controls and continuous improvement — Set evaluation and acceptance criteria across accuracy, latency, resilience, cost and user outcomes; embed human review and feedback loops; and ensure privacy, security, records, model risk, explainability, accessibility, auditability and responsible AI requirements are built into the product lifecycle.
Scale, performance and value — Ensure the proposition delivers the capacity, accuracy, resilience and economics required at Group scale; monitor service, quality, consumption and unit economics; and provide value streams with evidence to assess benefits while they retain accountability for realised outcomes.
Cross-functional leadership — Align business, operations, product, engineering, architecture, AI and control teams; resolve trade-offs and ambiguity; and maintain momentum from discovery through scaled adoption.
Qualifications
Experience
Essential
Significant product leadership experience owning an enterprise AI, data, automation, document-processing or workflow platform from strategy through scaled adoption and measurable value.
Demonstrated success engaging business and value-stream teams to identify, shape, prioritise and onboard high-value use cases through clear intake, self-service, co-build and higher-touch delivery paths.
Strong understanding of intelligent document processing, including ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, configuration, evaluation, human review and downstream workflow integration.
Solid knowledge of, and product experience in, applying AI to automate end-to-end document processing, including large language models (LLMs), intelligent OCR, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic document-processing workflows.
Demonstrated success redesigning document-heavy journeys and translating user and process insight into reusable capabilities, roadmaps and sustained adoption.
Experience leading platform convergence across internal and third-party capabilities, including disciplined reuse, build, buy, extend and retire decisions.
Technical and architectural credibility across APIs, orchestration, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, observability, release controls and integrations.
Experience delivering in a large, regulated organisation, embedding privacy, security, records, auditability, responsible AI and human accountability.
Commercial and analytical acumen across investment cases, consumption economics, baselining, benefits attribution and outcome measurement.
Proven ability to align senior business, operations, product and technology stakeholders across geographies through influence.
Strongly Preferred
Experience launching or scaling Document Intelligence, intelligent document processing, OCR or AI-enabled operations across a large enterprise.
Experience with document-heavy banking or regulated workflows, such as onboarding, KYC, underwriting, payments, trade, legal, audit or operations.
Experience designing federated platform models that balance enterprise reuse with value-stream autonomy.
Demonstrated ability to learn rapidly and stay current with emerging industry trends, technologies and market developments in intelligent document processing
Experience establishing quality frameworks covering accuracy, precision and recall, human review, feedback loops and continuous learning.
Essential Capabilities
Strategic Mindset and Innovation:
Defines a coherent enterprise strategy and sequences capability and use-case investment toward measurable outcomes.
Customer and Value-Stream Focus:
Turns operational pain points and user needs into priority solutions, sustained adoption and durable partnerships.
Commercial and Outcome Orientation:
Directs investment toward reusable capabilities with the strongest evidence of enterprise value and transparent performance and consumption economics.
Manages Complexity and Ambiguity:
Distinguishes reusable platform needs from business-specific requirements and makes transparent trade-offs.
Collaborates and Persuades:
Builds alignment across platform and value-stream teams and resolves ownership and convergence decisions with evidence.
Action Oriented and Accountable:
Moves rapidly from discovery to delivery and holds teams accountable for quality, controls, adoption and value.
Builds Effective Teams:
Creates a strong multidisciplinary culture with clear roles and decision rights.
Drives Vision and Purpose:
Builds commitment to one coherent Document Intelligence proposition that accelerates delivery without duplicating common capabilities.

jobs.descriptionText:
Syndicate and Portfolio Management  Internship Programme 2027
On our Syndicate & Portfolio Management Internship Programme, you'll gain exposure to how large-scale financing is structured, distributed and managed across global markets. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you'll develop an understanding of credit, risk and portfolio management while helping to support clients and drive business growth across some of the world's most dynamic markets.
About the Internship Programme – how you’ll learn and grow
Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background.  Over 10 weeks, you’ll work on real business challenges, build future-ready skills, and gain insight into how we support clients, facilitate trade and finance growth across our markets. Working alongside colleagues across our global network, you’ll develop the skills, confidence and connections to accelerate your career. For many interns, this is the first step towards a graduate role with us.
The programme will support your development through:
A 10-week summer internship
A structured induction and orientation
Exposure to our products, clients and international network
Real projects and meaningful responsibilities from day one
Technical, professional and behavioural skills development
Support from managers, mentors and buddies
Opportunities to learn from senior leaders and industry experts
Community and volunteering initiatives
Where you could work
You’ll be placed into one of the following teams:
Credit Portfolio Analytics - Partner with CIB stakeholders to assess client creditworthiness, drive prudent lending decisions, and manage credit portfolio risk and returns, with a focus on optimizing risk-weighted assets (RWA).
Credit Portfolio Management - Provides data-driven analysis and insights to support informed decision-making, helping the Bank understand its clients, credit portfolio, and identify opportunities to improve performance and returns.
Syndicate and Financing Risk - Supports the structuring, pricing, risk management and distribution of loans and bonds, helping the Bank provide financing to clients while effectively managing risk and returns.
Bring the skills - we’ll help you build your career
We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.
We’re Looking For People Who Can
Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges
Think critically, solve problems and apply sound judgement.
Learn quickly, Stay curious and look for opportunities to grow and develop
Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with others
Adapt and perform in a fast-paced environment
Are curious about how businesses, markets and economies connect and grow.
For technical roles, we particularly value backgrounds in Finance & Banking, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics and Statistics.
Eligibility
To be eligible for this internship, you should be a penultimate year student, able to intern in June 2027, and start full time in July 2028. You should have the permanent legal right to work in the country you’re applying to.
You can only submit one application within a six-month period, so take time to review our opportunities and apply for the role that best fits your interests, skills and career goals.
Key Dates
Assessment Centres: November 2026 onwards
Start Date: July 2027
About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)
We are a super-connector for many of the world’s largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth. We work with governments, financial institutions, and some of the world’s most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest, and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.
What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory, and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it’s needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What we offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global
Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.
Recruitment Assessments
Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers
